b1-reopen.message: reopenOrder writes paid → pending_payment, which no spec transition declares.
b1-reopen.hint: Declare this transition in the spec with impl: src/admin/orders.ts#reopenOrder, or remove the write.

b2-guard-bypass.message: refund: role(admin) (requireRole) is called on some paths but not all before the write (required by actor admin).
b2-guard-bypass.hint: Call requireRole on every path from refundOrder to the write, before any early return.

b3-refund-race.message: refund: refundOrder reads the entity (db.orders.get) and writes refunded outside one atomic scope; the spec says atomic.
b3-refund-race.hint: Wrap the read and write in one transaction or use a conditional update.

b4-webhook-dup.message: payment_succeeded: onPaymentSucceeded writes paid from any state (no status check before the write); the spec allows only pending_payment.
b4-webhook-dup.hint: Check that status is 'pending_payment' before the write, inside the same atomic scope.

b5-undeclared-effect.message: expire: expireOrder calls stripe.refund (stripe.refunds.create), which the spec does not declare for expire.
b5-undeclared-effect.hint: Declare stripe.refund under expire.effects, or remove the call.
